title: Ambient etale/pro-etale direct-image comparison as the specified counit mate
statement:
Let $u$ be a universe, let $A$ be a commutative ring in $\mathrm{Type}(u+1)$, and let $f:X	o Y$ be a morphism of schemes in universe $u$ [def-pc-scheme]. Use the ordinary uncompleted derived categories $D(W_{\mathrm{et}},A)=D(\operatorname{Sh}(W_{\mathrm{et}},\operatorname{Mod}(A)))$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and their pro-etale analogues with the constant coefficient ring $A$ and the ordinary operations $Lf_{\mathrm{pro}}^*\dashv Rf_{\mathrm{pro},*}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write $Lf_{\mathrm{et}}^*\dashv Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}$ for the analogous ordinary etale derived adjunction, and $S_W=D(
u_W^*)$ for exact comparison inverse image applied termwise [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Define $d_{A,f}:Lf_{\mathrm{pro}}^*S_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}S_XLf_{\mathrm{et}}^*$ by first identifying $Lf_{\mathrm{pro}}^*$ with $D(f_{\mathrm{pro}}^*)$, then localizing the canonical exact inverse-image square $f_{\mathrm{pro}}^*
u_Y^*\xrightarrow{\sim}
u_X^*f_{\mathrm{et}}^*$, with the canonical localization-composition identifications, and finally using $D(f_{\mathrm{et}}^*)\xrightarrow{\sim}Lf_{\mathrm{et}}^*$. Define the ambient direct-image comparison $\delta_{A,f}:S_YRf_{\mathrm{et},*}\longrightarrow Rf_{\mathrm{pro},*}S_X$ to be the mate of $d_{A,f}$ under these two geometric adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Thus its component at $K$ is the transpose of $Lf_{\mathrm{pro}}^*S_YRf_{\mathrm{et},*}K\xrightarrow{d_{A,f}}S_XLf_{\mathrm{et}}^*Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}K\xrightarrow{S_X(\varepsilon_{\mathrm{et},K})}S_XK$. This defines the canonical transformation on all ordinary unbounded derived objects; it does not assert invertibility of its components or require boundedness, finiteness of $A$, or quasi-compactness or quasi-separatedness of $f$.

def directImageComparisonAmbient
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    R(Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f) ⋙
        (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y).mapDerivedCategory ⟶
      (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f)
